notes.entropy: nats, mean over heads and queries; backbone causal batch-1 recomputation; DiT with key masks
notes.real: first T_real steps x D_real dims of the (action_horizon x max_action_dim) padded tensor; D_real is the concatenated size of the decoded action keys (assumed to come first)
notes.rel_change: ||x_s - x_ref|| / ||x_ref|| for the same observation and seed against the first scale
notes.sampler: velocity = action_decoder output, sample = action_encoder input; 4 Euler steps unless the checkpoint says otherwise
